- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Place sign-in before adoption certificate creation: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet selection/upload and prior to generating the adoption certificate. (why: Sign-in conversion is 80.0% with a long mean duration (567s); placing sign-in directly before formal pet adoption connects account creation directly with finalizing pet ownership.)
1: [home, new_screen] Interactive pet desktop visibility check screen: Insert a dedicated desktop visibility verification screen right before the final home introduction screen. (why: Support logs show multiple reports of pets failing to render on desktop or app failing to launch properly.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split layout story intro screen redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout layout separating the background lore from path selection highlights. (why: The choose_path funnel step shows a high mean duration (514s vs 8s median), indicating users stall on reading narrative content.)
3: [finish, copy] Clear desktop interaction instructions on home intro: Update the home intro text to explicitly detail how to control, hide, and interact with the pet on the desktop. (why: Support tickets show user confusion after setup about controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account persistence sign-in provider hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen prompting returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split layout for adoption certificate screen: Change adoption certificate layout to split view side-by-side display. (why: Adoption has a 78.7% conversion rate and median duration of 89s; split view provides cleaner visual separation between certificate data and preview.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop launch troubleshooting tip on waiting screen: Display a helpful tip on the waiting screen explaining what to check if the pet window does not open automatically. (why: Support received reports of pets not showing on desktop or the app stalling before first view.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo upload guidance hint for custom pet creation: Add photo selection quality guidelines as a hint on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received complaints about custom pet creation failing or yielding unexpected visual results.)
8: [choose_path, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign choose_path screen to a carousel layout to showcase path options in a clear visual sequence. (why: Choose path has an 8s median but 514s mean time, showing that a significant subset of users get stuck making a choice.)
